acceptanceCriteria.text: `references/INTEGRATION.md` states the two-skill split (`ws-spec-memo` = wiring/`specMemo.*`; runtime ops = `ws-memo`) and that `ws-spec-memo` does not own search/get/gc/promote/canvas/SSE/status/rank/backup/sync.

`INTEGRATION.md` tells agents that after `specMemo.enabled: true` and MCP registration they must load `ws-memo` from the spec-memo package/clone (`{skillsRoot}/ws-memo` or copy from spec-memo `.agents/skills/ws-memo/`).
`SKILL.md` includes a one-line runtime next step pointing at `/ws-memo` (spec-memo skill) after setup/check/bootstrap/import/disable paths without pasting an 8-tool MCP table.

`references/MCP-TEMPLATE.json` keeps stdio `memo serve` / npx serve as default snippets and adds an optional comment pointing at spec-memo `ws-memo/references/MCP-TEMPLATE.json` for SSE/status ports `3000`/`3001` and canvas `4100`.

When `specMemo.enabled` is explicit `true`, `check_spec_memo.cjs` reports (warn, exit 0) whether MCP `spec-memo` is expected and whether `{skillsRoot}/ws-memo/SKILL.md` exists; missing `ws-memo` does not fail the check.
When `specMemo.enabled` is not explicit `true`, `check_spec_memo.cjs` exits 0 without requiring `ws-memo` or MCP registration.
`tools.md` vault reroute notes (when `specMemo.enabled`) point trap/search follow-ups at `ws-memo` / `/ws-memo` instead of expanding `ws-spec-memo` into a command encyclopedia.
`evals/evals.json` adds an eval that after setup the agent loads `ws-memo` for search/promote-style ops and does not invent a ninth MCP tool or duplicate SURFACE.md inside `ws-spec-memo`.
Setup interview Recommended defaults still keep `specMemo.enabled: false` (no change that makes enable the Recommended first choice).
No SURFACE.md (or other full vault command encyclopedia) is copied into `ws-spec-memo` skill docs.
